CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT
Conferment of Powers - Order

IN pursuance of the powers vested in me under the Section 2(2) of the Co-operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 read withCo-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1992,I Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co-operativeDevelopment and Vocational Training and Skills Development do hereby confer on the persons appointed to assist theCommissioner of Co-operative Development and the Registrar of Co-operative Societies and specified in the Column I of theSchedule hereto, from the date specified in Column II under Co-operative Societies Law, No. 5 of 1972 read with Co-operativeSocieties (Amendment) Act, No. 32 of 1983 and the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1992 and under therules made there under, the powers specified in coloum III of the said schedule.
RISHAD BATHIUDEEN,Minister of Industry and Commerce,Resettlement of Protracted DisplacedPersons, Co-operative Development and VocationalTraining and Skills Development.
13th November, 2019.Colombo.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A – G31556 – 12 (2019/11)
